record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Let V be a simple C2-cofinite vertex operator algebra with V(0)=C1, V(n)=0 for n<0, V' equivalent to V, and let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V, without assuming complete reducibility. Do the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among all g-twisted V-modules satisfy associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.3. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the two conditions in Conjecture 5.1 and let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V. Then the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy the associativity, commutativity and modular invariance properties.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V=\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}V_{(n)}$ be a simple vertex operator algebra over $\mathbb{C}$ such that:
(i) $V_{(0)}=\mathbb{C}\mathbf{1}$ and $V_{(n)}=0$ for $n<0$;
(ii) $V$ is $C_2$-cofinite, i.e. $\dim V/C_2(V)<\infty$ where $C_2(V)=\mathrm{span}\{u_{-2}v : u,v\in V\}$;
(iii) $V$ is isomorphic to its contragredient module $V'$.
Let $G$ be a finite group of automorphisms of $V$. Do not assume that the category of (generalized) $V$-modules is semisimple, so logarithmic modules and logarithmic intertwining operators must be considered.

For each $g\in G$, consider the category of grading-restricted generalized $g$-twisted $V$-modules, and the spaces of (logarithmic) twisted intertwining operators of types $\binom{W_3}{W_1\,W_2}$ where $W_i$ is a $g_i$-twisted $V$-module ($i=1,2,3$) with $g_3=g_1g_2$.

Prove or disprove: the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among all $g$-twisted $V$-modules ($g\in G$) satisfy the associativity property (the product of two such operators can be expanded as an iterate, and vice versa, in the sense of analytic continuation and convergence of the relevant multivalued series), the commutativity property (products of two such operators in different orders are analytic continuations of each other), and the modular invariance property (the space spanned by appropriate shifted pseudo-$q$-traces of products of geometrically modified twisted logarithmic intertwining operators is invariant under the action of $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$).
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made: associativity and commutativity for (logarithmic) twisted intertwining operators among g-twisted modules over C2-cofinite VOAs have been established in work on twisted intertwining operators for not-necessarily-commuting automorphisms, and modular invariance of (logarithmic) intertwining operators in the untwisted C2-cofinite setting was proven in the 2024 Communications in Mathematical Physics paper (arXiv:2305.15152). However, a complete proof of all three properties (associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance) simultaneously for the twisted logarithmic case under the stated hypotheses does not yet appear to be fully established in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Modular Invariance of (Logarithmic) Intertwining Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Spaces spanned by analytic extensions of pseudo-q-traces of products of geometrically-modified logarithmic intertwining operators among grading-restricted generalized V-modules are invariant under modular transformations for C2-cofinite VOAs.
status_evidence.claim: Modular invariance proven in untwisted logarithmic C2-cofinite case.

status_evidence.title: Intertwining operators among twisted modules associated to not-necessarily-commuting automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Construction and study of twisted intertwining operators among g-twisted V-modules for g in a (not-necessarily-abelian) finite group of automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational framework for twisted (logarithmic) intertwining operators established.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness for Twisted Fusion Products in Vertex Operator Algebra Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work proving C1-cofiniteness results for twisted logarithmic intertwining operators, extending the structural theory.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing progress on properties of twisted logarithmic intertwining operators.
